data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Update or remove test_runner_rejects_missing_api_key. The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY guard has moved into llm-api-call.sh. The runner no longer validates the key directly, so the existing test asserting the runner exits non-zero when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset must be updated: either (a) drop it (coverage belongs to test-llm-api-call.sh) or (b) reframe it to assert that when llm-api-call.sh exits non-zero, the runner treats the response as empty/inconclusive (fail-open path). If (b), wire the mock to exit 1 and assert FINDINGS_JSON contains the inconclusive fallback.
